title: DrDuc Translator Master Execution Plan
description: Non-LLM Chinese-Vietnamese and English-Vietnamese translation system using dictionary migration, Trie, LuatNhan, RBMT, EAPEE, QA, TM and desktop workflow.

enhanced_requirements.preprocessing: Scan, preserve structure, convert Traditional to Simplified Chinese, and resolve Pinyin before terminology and translation stages.
enhanced_requirements.syntax_rules: Build grammar transfer and disambiguation rules for Chinese-Vietnamese without dependency on flat bilingual dictionaries only.
enhanced_requirements.incremental_learning: Improve through project state, translation memory, candidate rules, and reviewer-approved upgrades.

tasks.details: Baseline stabilized: parser blocker fixed, full Python test suite green, tracker/docs aligned, README boundary updated, and obsolete planning sources removed.

Foundation closed: full Phase 01 test suite passes (`91 passed`), benchmark/rebuild workflow is reproducible, compiler now separates runtime entries from reference_entries, normalization_rules, audit_events, and entry_readings, Babylon/Mark/LacViet/ThieuChuu/History migrations are operational, compiled DB was rebuilt with 193,561 reference entries, 6,126 audit events, and 174,999 entry_readings, and PhienAm runtime was reduced from 1,420 to 264 residual entries while TrieEngine keeps single-character reading fallback from compiled metadata.

Python pre-translation pipeline is implemented: document importer, chapter splitter, production structure preserver, heuristic Traditional->Simplified conversion, safe Pinyin resolution, entity scanner, relationship builder, terminology suggester, and translation_config generation now create project artifacts under source/working directories and are covered by new integration tests.

Emotion detector, scene emotion state machine, pronoun resolver, and expression bank datasets are implemented under src/eapee and are integrated into RBMT dialogue handling with traceable pronoun overrides.

RBMT baseline is implemented in Python with sentence segmentation, placeholder-safe translation flow, LuatNhan integration, locked-entity overrides, ambiguity draft annotations, TM lookup, context updates, number conversion interplay, and clean/draft export.
QA engine is implemented with terminology, pronoun, emotion consistency, structure integrity, untranslated/ambiguity detection, length checks, and Markdown/JSON report generation.

Project manager, state DB schema, SQLite translation memory with exact/fuzzy lookup, candidate lifecycle helpers, runtime stats recording, and Obsidian-friendly summary export are implemented under src/state.
A baseline EN-VI engine is implemented with repo-local lexicon data, phrase-first matching, adjective+noun reordering, possessive handling, plural handling, tense hints, and regression tests.

Desktop workflow is fully operational across browser fallback and native Tauri execution: the Python sidecar exposes a versioned contract with project overview, artifact loading, dictionary search, candidate review, and QA commands; translation traces are promoted into candidate entries in project state; the React/Vite shell implements the seven planned screens with dictionary metadata inspection; src-tauri forwards frontend requests to the Python sidecar; and native icon assets are generated from `src-tauri/app-icon.svg` into `src-tauri/icons/` for bundle resources. Current repo verification after v23 baseline hardening: `python -m pytest` (`151 passed`). Earlier desktop verification covered `npm run build`, `npm exec tauri info`, `npm run tauri:build`, and a Windows smoke launch of `src-tauri/target/release/drduc-translator-desktop.exe`. On this machine the Rust toolchain is installed under `D:\App\Rust`, Visual Studio Build Tools 2022 under `D:\App\BuildTools\VS2022`, and the Windows SDK under `C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10`.

tasks.desc: v23.0 - Core Governance + Segment/Noise Safety Foundation
tasks.details: Implemented v23 foundations without rewriting the existing Python backbone: split TranslationMemory into tm_machine/tm_approved/tm_reviewed with machine-output guard and human-review promotion; added TraceEvent and per-segment trace_id; enriched RBMT traces and QA decision paths; added SegmentType/SegmentPacket/SegmentClassifier and pre-translation segment artifact export; added ProtectedSpanRegistry, NoiseFilter hard whitelist, ClauseSegmenter, RelationDetector, RuleClaim, RuleRegistry, and ConflictResolver. Full v23 production roadmap still needs AliasGraph, 7-pass EntityPipeline, grammar P0 transfer planner, context resolver/zero-pronoun, learning promotion gate, and metric regression gate.
